questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville gerne til USA, da jeg gerne ville opleve den amerikanske universitetskultur og kiggede derfor på de forskellige universiteter i USA. Her synes jeg bedst om Boulder grundet deres flotte natur og omgivelser.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Der var rigtig mange forskelige informationer, som man skulle have styr på og huske og det blev dermed et ret forvirrende process.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Vi havde en vejleder på universitet og derudover var der en introdag.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Det var ret svært at finde housing i byen, da det næsten kun var muligt at leje et værelse for et helt år og derudover var housing rigtigt dyrt. Jeg var dog heldig at finde et kollegie (Horizons International Crossroads), som jeg klart vil anbefale, da det både var forholdvis billigt

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Jeg ønskede inden jeg kom afsted at bo på campus, men kom desværre ikke ind. Dog fandt jeg et dorm udenfor campus og fik samme oplevelse men meget billigere, så at bo off campus er bestemt ikke dårligt.  Dog skal man være rigtig tideligt ude, da det var rigtig svært at finde bolig.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer:
Det var meget nemt. Der var en hjemmeside, hvor man kunne se alle de forskellige kurser og i hvilket tidsrum de lå og så kunne man bare vælge blandt dem. Hvis der var nogen forudsætninger for at tage kurset, så skulle man dog lige have godkendt, at man havde haft det i DK. 
Der stod ikke så meget om de forskellige kurser inden, så det var svært at vide så meget om dem inden man mødte op første dag.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Havde ikke brug for hjælp med mine kurser, men der var en vejleder man kunne skrive til, hvis det var nødvendigt.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alle de kurser jeg gerne ville have fra start af. Havde dog lige overset at en af dem ikke var "in person", og skulle dermed skifte lige inden studiestart. Dette var også nemt og kurset jeg gerne ville have var stadig ledigt.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Søge kurser når tilmeldingen åbner sig, da nogen af dem godt kan blive optaget, hvis man venter for længe. Sørg for de alle er "in person".

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Jeg havde et rigtig svært kursus, men dette var også en blanding af BA/MA kursus. Derudover havde jeg 3 BA kurser, som var nemmere end dem vi har tilsvarende i DK

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Vi havde normale forlæsninger ligesom på UCPH. Dog var der mange flere afleveringer og midterms, som endte med at tælle med i den samlede karakter, som er anderleds end herhjemme.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
EBIO 1210-001 General Biology 1
DNCE 1301-010 Hip-Hop Dance Technique 1
MCDB 1150-001 Introduction to Cellular and Molecular Biology
BCHM 4720-010 Metabolic Pathways and Human Disease

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: DNCE 1301-010 Hip-Hop Dance Technique 1 var virkelig et godt kursus og en god pause. Dog var det også ret tidskrævende og underviseren forventede man tog det seriøst, men helt sikkert det sjoveste kursus.

Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *
Other fees DKK per month *
What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Føler ikke der for noget uforventet.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Mad for dyre end forventet i Boulder. Jeg fik dog mad i hverdagen der hvor jeg bode, så dermed betalte jeg kun i weekenden eller når vi spiste ude.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der var mange forskellige klubber man kunne melde sig til gennem skolen og derudover lavede de tit aktivtiter - det gjorde jeg meget brug af i starten og var en god måde at møde nye mennesker på.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg var i en kort stund en del af kajak-, hiking- og roklubben, hvilken jeg kan anbefale

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Jeg var på mange weekendsture rundt og se nabostaterne, hvilke var nogen vildt gode ture. I thangsgiving var jeg på den klassiske Utah/Arizona tur, som jeg helt klart vil anbefale alle som skal til Boulder. Ellers lavede vi mange små halvdags hikes i både weekender og efter uni.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Synes det var meget nemt, da jeg ikke synes der var den store forskel. Dog både jeg på et internationalt kollegie, hvor der var folk fra hele verden, så her oplevede man meget kulturforskel, hvilket var sjovt at opleve, men ikke noget der gav nogen problemer.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Jeg hang mest ud med de andre danskere som var afsted eller med andre udvekslingsstuderede, men hvis man gerne vil have locale venner, så er en anbefaling at melde sig ind i nogen klubber gennem skolen.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Synes ikke der var nogen.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Folk i USA er super flinkt og vil gerne både hjælpe og snakke med en.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Vær åben fra start og lav så mange sociale ting som muligt, men lad vær med at få stress, hvis du ikke lige har fundet dine bedste venner fra dag et - det skal nok komme. 
Lad vær med at stress over skole og prøv at få så meget socialt ud af det som muligt.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: No

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Fik helt klart oplevet meget socialt og har fået meget ud af det på det personlige

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Man kunne til tider godt stresse over om man havde fået venner nok og om man gik glip af noget, hvis man havde en dag man ikke skulle noget, men synes hurtigt man kom over det, da man så udnyttede de dage til at slappe af, da der ellers skete meget det meste af tiden.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
